title: A producer brings their own sounds into a pack

steps.caption: You arrive on the dashboard, signed in to your own account
Open a project — the library browser is on screen
Choose Add pack — the new pack's name is waiting to be typed
Name the pack — it is listed, and empty
Drop three files on the pack — each lands as a sound
Audition one of the imported sounds
Find it by searching the library
Reload — the pack and all three sounds are still there
